description.text: Please contact us before application to confirm whether this English-medium program would be open this year.

duration.text: The Ancient Chinese History at Hebei University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5.photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: Applicants should reach HSK level 8 in principle, but for professional research-based students, they can be taught in English. So it is not a must to hold a HSK certificate.
